name: Aether Industries Ltd
title: Aether Industries Ltd - 543534 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell QoQ to INR3,051m (from INR3,188m) on logistics slippage and a one-off Q3 claim, while management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 29-30%, capex INR3,000-3,500m and CRAMS/CEM rising toward 70% of sales.

utilisation.quote: The capacity utilization at plant stands as under Site 2, 75%; Site 3, 70%; and Site 4, 55%.

capex.quote: the capex expected for financial year '27 is INR3,000 million to INR3,500 million.

triggers.label: LSM pricing up 20% YoY
triggers.quote: Pricing has been exceptionally strong over 20% year-on-year and 18% quarter-on-quarter in Q4.

triggers.label: Working capital days 194 → 179
triggers.quote: We have been able to reduce the overall working capital cycle to 179 days as on 31st March '26 from 194 days as of 31st March '25.

triggers.label: Site 5 capex INR1,500-1,600 crore over 4 years
triggers.quote: all put together, it will be approximately INR1,500 crores to INR1,600 crores, all in next 4 years

guidance.quote: We hope to keep margins stable between the 29% to 30% EBITDA margins as well as in the PAT around 19% to 20%.
as well as in the PAT around 19% to 20%.
we'll be again having a healthy working capital reduction, which we expect to be around 160 days at least.
you can expect INR200 crores to INR250 crores additional in the debt, not more than that.
we are very confident of achieving our vision of 70% of revenues coming from CRAMS and contract exclusive manufacturing business models by fiscal year '30.

red_flags.label: Q4 LSM volume dip and revenue decline blamed on logistics
red_flags.quote: in the month of March, we were not able to ship some of the products due to logistical issues.

red_flags.label: Working capital still ~179 days
red_flags.quote: Even though these levels remain elevated, the inventory days increased primarily on account of raw material purchase

red_flags.label: Fire incidents at warehouse and Site 2
red_flags.quote: a provision for loss of inventory on account of fire at an external warehouse near Site 1 on March 11, '26 a mounting to INR70 million

evasions.quote: we don't give the site -wise data. So I'll not be able to comment on that.
No, I don't think we would like to give you any time line
on the open platform, I cannot give you the cost of debt.
